# SQLite native library release tag
#
# The main build workflow (_build.yml) downloads pre-built sqlite native
# libraries from this GitHub Release tag instead of recompiling the C
# sources on every CI run.
#
# To update the native libraries (e.g. after bumping sqlite-jdbc version,
# changing compiler flags, or adding a new platform):
#   1. Run the "Build SQLite Natives" workflow (sqlite-natives.yml) with a
#      new tag (e.g. sqlite-natives-v2) to produce fresh binaries.
#   2. Update this file to the new tag.
#   3. Commit and push both changes together.
sqlite-natives-v1
